allowances.number_form: spoken number words and ASR digits normalize to the same integer value
allowances.currency_symbol: ASR writes '$' where the narrator spoke 'dollars'
allowances.percent_symbol: ASR writes '%' where the narrator spoke 'percent'
allowances.homophone: acoustically identical pairs the transcriber cannot distinguish: inn/in
allowances.limitation: a homophone allowance means ASR cannot decide the token. It is not evidence the audio is correct, and owner listening remains the check.

limitations: ASR cannot prove an unclipped final phoneme and does not replace owner listening.
note: The pinned small.en read produced one undeclared difference, band/ban, a single final consonant. The stronger medium.en read of the same bytes transcribes the word correctly, so the audio is exact and the pinned model dropped a phoneme. Superseded small.en record kept alongside.
